functions.signature: float LerpAngle(float From, float To, float Ratio)
functions.note: Delta = Remap(UnwindDegrees(To - From)); result = UnwindDegrees(From + Delta * Ratio). Delta in (175, 180] is flipped to the negative side.

functions.signature: FRotator LerpRotation(const FRotator& From, const FRotator& To, float Ratio)
functions.note: Per axis like LerpAngle (vector path: normalize delta, remap > 175 by -360, FMA, normalize). If every |Delta| <= 1e-4 the function returns To unchanged. Rotators are [pitch, yaw, roll].

functions.signature: float InterpolateAngleConstant(float Current, float Target, float DeltaTime, float Speed)
functions.note: Speed <= 0 or |Delta| <= Speed*DeltaTime returns Target (NOT unwound); otherwise UnwindDegrees(Current + Sign(Remap(Delta)) * MaxDelta).

functions.signature: float DamperExactAngle(float Current, float Target, float DeltaTime, float HalfLife)
functions.note: Delta = UnwindDegrees(Target - Current); |Delta| <= 1e-4 returns Target; else UnwindDegrees(Current + Remap(Delta) * DamperExactAlpha(DeltaTime, HalfLife)).

functions.signature: FRotator DamperExactRotation(const FRotator& Current, const FRotator& Target, float DeltaTime, float HalfLife)
functions.note: Per axis like DamperExactAngle (vector path). If every |normalized delta| <= 1e-4 the function returns Target. Rotators are [pitch, yaw, roll]. Alpha is a float32 value used as a double.

functions.signature: FQuat InterpolateQuaternionFast(const FQuat& Current, const FQuat& Target, float DeltaTime, float Speed)
functions.note: Speed <= 0 or Current.Equals(Target) (tolerance 1e-4 per component) returns Target; else GetNormalized(FastLerp(Current, Target, Clamp01(Speed*DeltaTime))). FastLerp flips the sign of Current's weight when Dot < 0 (shortest route). Quats are [x,y,z,w].

functions.signature: FQuat GetTwist(const FQuat& Quaternion, const FVector& TwistAxis = FVector::UpVector)
functions.note: Projects the vector part of the quaternion on TwistAxis and normalizes (TwistAxis is not normalized by the function; the default axis is the up vector). Quats are [x,y,z,w].
